verdict.rationale: Community Phone documents 'advanced call activity with history and trends', which is a thin form of call-volume reporting, and business plans send instant missed-call alerts and let admins manage users and numbers from a dashboard. Nothing documents an analytics view that breaks out answer rate or missed calls per number or per teammate, and the call-activity feature appears in a home-plan context. missing for 10: answer-rate metrics, missed-call counts in reports (alerts are only notifications), per-number breakdowns, per-teammate breakdowns, business-plan analytics documentation, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a support leader, I can see call volume, answer rate, and missed calls per number and per teammate

citations.quote: advanced call activity with history and trends
Customers manage their line, calls and voicemail in the Community Phone app and the online dashboard.
